sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.UA > 8.0 AND T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN T2.UA > 6.5 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS Is_UA_Normal
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 57266
ORDER BY T2.Date DESC
LIMIT 1
